title: Drop doc renders
lead: Stop generating and committing renders of docs/how-it-works.md. The Markdown with its Mermaid diagrams is the only artifact (GitHub renders Mermaid); the owner exports a PDF or HTML when needed. Remove the committed `docs/how-it-works.html` and `docs/how-it-works.pdf`, `scripts/render-docs.sh`, and every rule, link and checklist step that mentions them. **Not in this slice:** changing what any diagram says; the docs freeze pass (sq-54); the release (sq-53).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner decision (2026-10-30), verbatim, on the sq-60 architect's question about making poppler a render prerequisite: "let's just drop all the render to pdfs-- too much. markdowns with diagrams are fine, and i can export if needed". Scope answers, verbatim: What drops "PDF and HTML renders; keep only the .md (Recommended)" (option text: "docs/how-it-works.md with Mermaid diagrams stays the single source (GitHub renders Mermaid). Remove .pdf and .html, scripts/render-docs.sh and its docs tests. You export when you want one."). Guidance edits "New 1.0.0 slice 'Drop doc renders' (Recommended)" (option text: "One slice edits CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, goals, README, release.md and removes the render files/script/tests; it lands before sq-54 and sq-53, which then simply skip the re-render steps. You approve the AGENTS.md and goals wording in the spec check."). sq-60 fate "Retire sq-60 and discard its worktree (Recommended)". sq-52 (landed) changed one diagram to top-down for the PDF; the Markdown keeps that layout.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- Remove: `docs/how-it-works.html`, `docs/how-it-works.pdf`, `scripts/render-docs.sh`.
- `AGENTS.md` (owner approves the wording before the implementer starts; draft below), `CONTRIBUTING.md` (the docs section on renders, the `scripts/` layout line, quire and Mermaid prerequisites, the diagram-rules bullet keeps its plain-language rule and drops the PDF clipping check), `README.md` (the How it works row: drop the PDF link), `docs/release.md` and any release checklist step that regenerates the docs.
- The goals prose (`slicer prose edit goals`, done by the orchestrator after the owner approves the draft): "**Explained in plain language.** docs/how-it-works.md, with Mermaid diagrams, kept current at every architectural review."
- Tests: `tests/squalify.Cli.Tests/DocsTests.cs` (a new test below). No existing test reads the renders (checked with rg).
- AGENTS.md draft (pending owner approval): the Docs paragraph ends "...with Mermaid diagrams; it is the only copy (no committed renders)."; "Regenerate the renders in the same change." is deleted; the "Rendering" bullet is deleted; the "Same-commit rule" bullet stays. CONTRIBUTING.md and the sq-54/sq-53 steps lose their re-render and html/pdf-count checks.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- **No renders remain:** a docs test asserts that `docs/how-it-works.html`, `docs/how-it-works.pdf` and `scripts/render-docs.sh` do not exist and that README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md and docs/release.md contain no mention of them or of `.pdf` renders (the README mention of the pdf magic bytes feature is not a render: match the specific file names and "render-docs"/"quire").
- **Links still resolve:** the existing link test on the docs (if any) passes with the PDF link removed; `docs/how-it-works.md` is still linked from the README.
- Mutation-check: restore one removed file name in README and see the test fail.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Wait for the owner's approval of the AGENTS.md draft. 2. Write the test, watch it fail. 3. Remove the files; edit the guidance; run the docs tests. 4. `slicer check`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes; `rg -n "render-docs|how-it-works\.(html|pdf)|quire" --glob '!.slicer' --glob '!docs/process' --glob '!docs/reviews'` returns nothing.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: The owner commits. Do not commit; never add Co-Authored-By or similar lines.
